csv_agency: U S Dept of Air Force (55th Contracting Squadron)
csv_scope_of_work: The 55th Wing at Offutt AFB anticipates a requirement for an Architect-Engineer (A-E) services contract. The Government contemplates awarding up to five (5) Single-Award Task-Order Contracts (SATOCs) to be used on an as-needed basis.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: FA4600_A-E_2026- Contract Number: FA4600R0004- Solicitation documents available online. - Up to 4 contracts may be awarded- This is a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation notice
title: Architect-Engineer Services for Offutt AFB
short_description: Indefinite-delivery architect-engineer services for building and infrastructure projects at Offutt Air Force Base.
project_location: Offutt Air Force Base, Nebraska, USA
project_scope: On-call architect-engineer services contract for Offutt AFB with up to five single-award task-order contracts for as-needed projects. Disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. The notice indicates a total construction cost of 49,000,000 USD across the program.
services: Architect-engineer services under SATOCs, including architecture, structural engineering, civil engineering, rehabilitation/refurbishment, interior design, programming, surveying/GIS, cost estimating, environmental, electrical, fire protection, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call A-E contract with broad disciplines and no defined technical structure.
- Target market is general building, not a specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but only as one discipline among many.
- Military air force base context is generally low strategic relevance for sbp.
- Multiple task-order contract without concrete project scope reduces fit and priority.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as total construction cost.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated. The notice only provides a total construction cost of 49,000,000 USD for the overall program; no reliable sbp fee estimate is possible because task-order sizes, disciplines, and structural scope are undefined.
references_qualifications: Bidders must provide architect-engineer capabilities across multiple disciplines, including architecture, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, fire protection, environmental, surveying/GIS, cost estimating, interior design, programming, and rehabilitation/refurbishment. Specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: U.S. Department of the Air Force, 55th Contracting Squadron; Offutt Air Force Base, Nebraska, USA; Contact: Blaine Terry; Phone: 402-232-2517; Email: blaine.terry.2@us.af.mil; Website: https://sam.gov/opp/22fde05b04a4491ebdab02947c708250/view?keywords=&sort=-modifiedDate&index=opp&is_active=true&page=1000-vendor
notes: Combined synopsis/solicitation notice. Source text contains a discrepancy: it states up to five SATOCs are contemplated, while comments also say up to four contracts may be awarded. This appears to be an indefinite-delivery/multi-project procurement rather than a single defined project.
